svg.aria-label: A formula moves from text to a Quire outcome. tl-parse turns MLTL text into a formula document, tl-rewrite returns a rewritten document, and tl-mltl evaluates it against a trace. In tests, tl-oracle evaluates the same formula and trace independently and the verdicts are compared. quire-mltl maps the result to a Boolean Value or a typed NonValue reason. All documents use the vocabulary of tl-syntax.
